mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is to enforce HTTPS everywhere: plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts or internal services, and no plaintext exception applies. This is consistent with the separate recorded decision to keep certificate verification enabled on all builds, with no exceptions for development.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
